title: The mixed-unit transpose of the fixed realized proper/open scalar map
statement: Let ell,K_0,f:X→Y,c,E,L,iota satisfy the hypotheses of lem-sf-compact-support-finite-scalar-mate-normalization. For every integral constructible K and n≥0 define q to be completed scalar extension of compactRealization_E, followed by coefficientExchange(systemCompactScalar), followed by compactRealization_L inverse [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization]. Let r_E and r_L be the specified compact-support finite reduction isomorphisms [def-weil-compact-support-finite-action], and let R be finite derived scalar restriction. Then the output mixed unit [def-weil-mixed-reduction-unit] followed by R applied to (q_n followed by r_L) equals r_E followed by finite E-compact support of the input mixed unit followed by sfCompactSupportRestriction. This is a transpose equation for the explicit ambient map q, without a given b, without a universal-property assertion, and without asserting q invertible.

proof.text: Expand coefficientExchange into its scalar alpha, the derived limit of systemCompactScalar, and scalar beta. Naturality of the reduction/limit counit moves the system mate through the counit, and the triangle identity cancels the inserted reconstruction pair. The projection equations for the fixed compactRealization identify the operation counits with r_E and r_L.

The scalar counit is the coherent coefficient reduction comparison. On a flat-term K-flat representative its tensor association sends the mixed unit to the finite scalar unit. The strict Roos comparison preserves the augmentation, including its zero shifted coordinate, so this identifies the actual completed unit and counit maps, rather than just their effect on cohomology.

Use the adjunction word defining systemCompactScalar: its proper factor is the direct-image scalar mate and its open factor is the inverse left-adjunction scalar mate. Pasting their unit/counit equations gives compact support of the input scalar unit followed by restriction comparison. Substitute the preceding normalization and projection equations. Naturality descends the equality through homotopy and derived localization and gives the displayed equation for q itself, without testing equality of system maps by evaluation.

mathlib_searches.query: A unit of scalar extension induces a bijection on morphisms to restricted scalars, and mates are uniquely determined by composing with the unit

theorem sfCompactSupportRealizedScalarTranspose
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (E L : Type u) [Field E] [Field L]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [Algebra (Padic l) L]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[Padic l] L) (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) (n : ℕ) :
    let FX := sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor l K₀ hl c E
    let TX := sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension 0 l
      (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) E L ι X
    let q := (integralScalarExtension l E L ι Y).map
        ((FrobeniusExchange.compactRealization l E K₀ hl f c).hom.app K) ≫
      (FrobeniusExchange.coefficientExchange l E L ι
        (FrobeniusExchange.systemDerivedOpen l E c.i ⋙ FrobeniusExchange.systemDirect l E c.g)
        (FrobeniusExchange.systemDerivedOpen l L c.i ⋙ FrobeniusExchange.systemDirect l L c.g)
        (FrobeniusExchange.systemCompactScalar l E L ι c)).app K ≫
      (FrobeniusExchange.compactRealization l L K₀ hl f c).inv.app (TX.obj K)
    sfMixedCompletedReductionUnit l E L ι Y n (FX.obj K).obj ≫
        (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Y
          (integralScalarQuotientMap l E L ι n)).mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l L Y n).map q ≫
            (sfCompactSupportFiniteReductionIso l K₀ hl c L (TX.obj K) n).hom) =
      (sfCompactSupportFiniteReductionIso l K₀ hl c E K n).hom ≫
        (sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate
          (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) c).map
          (sfMixedCompletedReductionUnit l E L ι X n K.obj) ≫
        (sfCompactSupportRestriction c
          (integralScalarQuotientMap l E L ι n)).hom.app
          ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l L X n).obj (TX.obj K).obj)
